notes.title: Four new PvP modes have been added to Robotry!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce all new versus game modes coming to Robotry! in a free update!

The new PvP modes include:
* Volleyball, where you play in teams and try to make Pengu hit the ground on the opposing side
* Bounce the Pengu, where you try to get Pengu to the goal area as many times as possible
* Waypoint Chase, where you need to go fast from waypoint to waypoint in small arenas
* Gem Hunt, where you're trying to gather as many gems as possible in small arenas

We've had a ton of fun testing these modes, hope you'll enjoy them as well!

notes.title: One Leg Challenge Mode added to Robotry!
notes.content:
If you thought that the normal campaign of Robotry! was as challenging as it gets, think again! We're adding a brand new mode that unlocks once you've played through the first 2 worlds of Robotry!

In the One Leg Challenge Mode, you'll play a slightly modified version of the existing campaign, except that you'll only have one leg. Most of the levels will play very differently with a different number of limbs. Just like the normal campaign, you can play this mode in single player, or have 2-4 people join forces in co-op.

We're also working on more free updates. So far we're ready to announce competitive Gem Hunt, which will be added to Robotry! early 2023!

notes.title: Bugfix update November 2022
notes.content:
We've released our first update to Robotry! with more to come! Changes in this patch:

[list]
[*] Total play time is now shown in save slot menu
[*] Fixed a few levels where it was possible to get stuck
[*] Fixed minor visual issues in levels
[*] Fixed camera issues in co-op mode in some levels
[*] Fixed pipe enter animation sometimes getting stuck for a few seconds
[*] Entering pause menu now pauses the game
[*] Disconnecting a controller now enters pause menu
[*] Fixed button prompts flickering when throwing heebos
[*] Increased minimum font size in options
[*] Tweaked robot-robot collision particle effects
[/list]

notes.title: Developers play in an all-new launch celebration stream!
notes.content:
We want to celebrate the launch by introducing ourselves and letting you watch our three-person development team play two different co-op modes! It's either three robots on screen or one robot with three legs - see for yourself which is more chaotic. ːsteamhappyː

You can also join us in an AMA about the game at https://www.reddit.com/r/NintendoSwitch at 10:00 Pacific / 13:00 Eastern / 19:00 Central European time!

notes.title: See the devs play the demo during Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase!
notes.content: Get hyped for the game launch as two of the devs, Ville and Harri will play through the demo on a recorded broadcast!

notes.title: Watch developers play Robotry! Next Fest Demo in co-op
notes.content:
Two of the devs, Ville and Harri will grab their gamepads and play through 2 co-op modes, one of which will be the experimental shared robot mode. So if you want to see expert robot handlers jumping around without a jump button, tune in to the Steam broadcast!

The demo is also currently available for download. It's going to be out for a limited time, so get it while it lasts!

notes.title: Robotry! during Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
If you want to see expert robot handlers at work, we're going to play Robotry! on a Steam broadcast! Two of the devs, Olli and Harri will grab their gamepads and show how to play a platformer without a jump button. We're also available to answer your questions in chat!

And if you want to play Robotry!, the free demo will be available during Steam Next Fest starting June 13th. We're super excited to finally let more people have a go at the game! The demo will be available for a limited time, so get it while it lasts.

notes.title: Robotry is coming to Steam in fall 2022!
notes.content:
🤖 We're happy to announce that the game will launch in the fall this year! 🤖

We're hard at work designing the rest of the game, and we can't wait to let people start playing. To see more of what we have in store for you, check out the new trailer!

And don't forget to wishlist for our eternal gratitude! 🙏
